title: Uploaded, not ready
fullTitle: 100% Uploaded. Why Isn't My File Ready?

captions.text: The bar says 100%. The file is not ready.
Nothing is wrong with the bar. It measured something else.
Four stages: transfer, acceptance, processing, availability.
The bar only showed the first.
XHR upload events: loaded / total, only if lengthComputable.
Those are request-body bytes, multipart overhead included.
An 82-byte file travelled as a 232-byte request body.
After the last byte, the response arrives separately: 202 Accepted + job ID.
Accepted means stored and queued, not processed. Result now: 409.
Polling the authorised status endpoint: accepted → ready.
Only then does the result open. Another user gets 404.
Same flow, different file: 100% transferred, 202 Accepted.
The worker finds bad rows. Job failed, with a reason.
Replace the single bar with four statuses.
Processing is a plain state: no invented percentage.
Bytes transferred is not the same as work completed.
